strategy_catalog.name: Vectorized RowMuls/RowDivs - Minimal
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Replace scalar RowMulsImpl/RowDivsImpl loops with vectorized RowMuls/RowDivs helper functions. These functions use Mul/Div with BinaryRepeatParams to achieve row-wise broadcast scaling at vector width (64 fp16/cycle) instead of scalar width (1/cycle).

VEC2_row_ops.RowMuls: RowMuls(oPrevUb_, oPrevUb_, expStateUb, dealRows, dim, actualDim)
VEC2_row_ops.RowDivs: RowDivs(oNewUb, oNewUb, sumStateUb, dealRows, dim, actualDim)
